help.how.title.defaultMessage: How TodayZ works for your shop

help.how.stock.body.defaultMessage: Add products with a price and how many you have. Customers nearby see what is in stock.

help.how.orders.body.defaultMessage: A new order rings on the “Orders” screen. Accept it, take part of it, or say why you cannot before its timer runs out.

help.how.pickup.body.defaultMessage: At pickup the customer shows a code. Enter it on the order to complete the handover.

help.how.counter.body.defaultMessage: Ring up walk-in sales on “Sell”, even offline. Stock goes down as you sell.

help.how.credits.body.defaultMessage: Customers earn and spend TodayZ credits. What they spend at your shop is added to your credit account.

help.how.payouts.body.defaultMessage: Each month a statement closes and what you are owed is paid by UPI.

help.faq.timer.q.defaultMessage: What happens if I do not accept an order in time?

help.faq.timer.a.defaultMessage: The order lapses and the customer is told. Missed orders lower where your shop shows in search, so keep the “Orders” screen open while you are open.

help.faq.code.q.defaultMessage: The pickup code does not work

help.faq.code.a.defaultMessage: A code works only while the order is accepted or ready, and only once. After too many wrong tries it locks: ask the customer to tap “Get a new code” in their app.

help.faq.credits.q.defaultMessage: Where do the credits customers spend go?

help.faq.credits.a.defaultMessage: Credits a customer spends at your shop go to your credit account and are paid out with your payout. Cashback you give comes out of the same account.

help.faq.payout.a.defaultMessage: A statement closes on the 1st of each month. What you are owed is paid by UPI, and the “Credits” screen shows it as paid with the UTR reference. A payout waits while your verification is incomplete.

help.faq.visible.q.defaultMessage: Why can customers not see my shop?

help.faq.visible.a.defaultMessage: Your shop shows once it is approved, live and open, and only products with stock show in search.

help.faq.staff.a.defaultMessage: A cashier sells and handles orders. A manager also runs stock, offers and cashiers. The owner can do everything, including payouts and managers.

help.faq.close.q.defaultMessage: How do I close my business?

help.faq.close.a.defaultMessage: There is no delete in the app. Contact support and we will help you.
